description: Xaurr Payouts: ask a customer to pay into your balance by Mobile Money (POST /collections). Test mode uses the Xaurr test numbers.

amount.description: Amount the customer pays, in the chosen currency.

currency.description: Currency of the account's country: GHS (Ghana), KES (Kenya), UGX (Uganda) or NGN (Nigeria).

phone.description: The customer's Mobile Money number with country code.

reference.description: Your own unique reference for this collection.

worker.description: Optional worker id to credit a share.

worker_share.description: Part of the amount credited to that worker (optional).

name: payouts_collect
title: Collect a payment into Payouts
